name: invero-pm
description: Project Manager agent and specialist team for construction and fit-out projects in any country. Watches a project folder's drawings, registers, programme/schedule and cost; keeps state and a live local dashboard; briefs specialists for claims and changes, programme analysis, tender comparison, scope of works, health checks, site reports, code compliance and close-out; runs every deliverable through brief, produce, independent review and owner sign-off, with statutory deadlines first. Adapts to the project's country and region through knowledge packs (Australia in depth, US starter, template for others). Scope is enforced in code and by a Write/Edit hook.
